taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-15, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve type, we analyze the resistivities of the layers in groups of three:

1.  **Layer 1-2-3**: 1132.2, 3621.5, 4447.9. Since 1132.2 < 3621.5 < 4447.9, the pattern is $r_1 < r_2 < r_3$, which is **A**.
2.  **Layer 2-3-4**: 3621.5, 4447.9, 4307.5. Since 3621.5 < 4447.9 > 4307.5, the pattern is $r_2 < r_3 > r_4$, which is **K**.
3.  **Layer 3-4-5**: 4447.9, 4307.5, 7664.9. Since 4447.9 > 4307.5 < 7664.9, the pattern is $r_3 > r_4 < r_5$, which is **H**.
4.  **Layer 4-5-6**: 4307.5, 7664.9, 12762.9. Since 4307.5 < 7664.9 < 12762.9, the pattern is $r_4 < r_5 < r_6$, which is **A**.

Combining these, the curve type is AKHA.

{"curve_type": "AKHA"}
